title: Vermicelli Jazzy Onigiri Bites
description: A unique fusion dish that combines the flavors of Asia and the Mediterranean. Quick, easy, and fun to make, these onigiri bites are perfect for snacking.

ingredients.name: Jazzy cheese
ingredients.notes: Mozzarella or similar melty cheese works well

ingredients.name: Turkish spices
ingredients.notes: Paprika, cumin, or sumac add a nice flavor

instructions: Cook vermicelli pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
Prepare Japanese short-grain rice according to package instructions.
Mix cooked vermicelli pasta and Japanese rice together.
Add shredded jazzy cheese, Turkish spices, and a pinch of salt to the mixture. Mix well.
Shape the mixture into small onigiri triangles.
Place a small amount of soy sauce on the surface of each onigiri, if using.
Gently press the edges of each onigiri to seal.
